roles.title: Feature implementer
roles.purpose: Implement one bounded source change and run focused validation.

roles.title: Security reviewer
roles.purpose: Independently review trust boundaries, secrets, authentication, telemetry, commands, and destructive risks.

roles.title: Test and QA specialist
roles.purpose: Design focused regressions, exercise failure modes, and verify acceptance criteria.

roles.title: UX specialist
roles.purpose: Review D-pad navigation, focus, overscan, geometry, motion, loading, empty, error, and accessibility states.

roles.title: Image analyst
roles.purpose: Inspect screenshots and captures and return structured visual evidence.

roles.title: Search and retrieval specialist
roles.purpose: Retrieve bounded repository evidence and primary external sources with citations.

roles.title: Device diagnostics specialist
roles.purpose: Perform bounded read-only Fire TV and Kodi inspection under the safe ADB runbook.

roles.title: Release steward
roles.purpose: Verify versions, manifests, signatures, artifacts, rollback, CI, and draft readiness.

roles.title: Publication executor
roles.purpose: Execute the exact owner-approved publication or deployment packet after all gates pass.
